item.title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration

exact_text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen explainer showing a seed sprouting. Use this exact voice-over: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Simple animation, no on-screen text or music.

item.tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

answer_sheet.Voice-over wording: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Simple animation showing the seed and its growth.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: English; voice choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Text and music: No on-screen text and no music.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
There is no on-screen text or music.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen educational explainer in simple clean 2D animation. One continuous static cutaway view of a single seed in brown soil, with open space above the soil and soft light from above. Show the germination process clearly in time lapse: first water droplets soak into the seed and it swells; then a root emerges and grows downward through the soil; then a green shoot grows upward out of the soil toward the light. Keep the same seed and composition throughout. Minimal shapes, gentle colors, clear botanical direction, easy to understand. An off-screen narrator speaks exactly this English voice-over, naturally paced to finish within 8 seconds: "A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light." Voice-over only. No music. No on-screen text, no labels, no captions, no subtitles, no logos.
